subject.title: feat(android): approve, reject, and remove device pairings from the phone

question: Should Android clients with existing `operator.pairing` or `operator.admin` grants expose gateway device-pairing administration while limited QR-bootstrap sessions retain CLI-only guidance?
rationale: This adds a new mobile authorization-management surface with onboarding and security-boundary implications that tests alone cannot settle.

options.title: Approve scope-limited Android administration
options.body: Keep the proposed advertised-method and granted-scope gating, then require real gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Defer mobile administration
options.body: Keep the current CLI-only management path until maintainers define a broader mobile pairing-management policy.

recommendation.title: Approve scope-limited Android administration
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed advertised-method and granted-scope gating, then require real gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR provides the detailed Android and gateway authorization rationale, making this the best available routing candidate.
